about: A grand staff round trip: two staves, one voice each, chords as one event with several heads, the right hand on the upper staff (G01 §7.6, §8.1, §8.2, A21, A24).
spec: G01 §7.6: a chord is one event with several heads; §8.2: limbOf(head) = head.limb ?? voice.limb ?? staff.limb with staff 1 RH, staff 2 LH.
